title: What can Fitliner do?
intro: Training, nutrition, health and your gym. Explore the tools that come together in one app.
availability: Availability varies by app version, account and participating gym. The Health Card requires access; phone entry requires compatible equipment and valid access rights.
rollout: New membership checkout, extended invoicing, trainer bookings and general offline entry are being rolled out separately. They are not available at every gym or for every account. Diamond discounts are not an active benefit yet.
footer: Your next step starts in Fitliner.
teaserBody: See how the app supports your training, nutrition, progress and gym life.

sections.title: Your day at a glance
items: Daily nutrition and personal progress overview.
Quick access to workouts, messages and your gym.
Pinned entry for supported gyms and your diamond balance.

sections.title: Workouts & training diary
sections.summary: From the plan to your last set.
items: Training plans, workout days, exercises and visual movement guides.
Custom exercises, sets, weights, repetitions, rest timers and repeat workouts.
History, records, charts and permission-based diary sharing; your own unfinished workout saves offline and syncs later.

sections.title: Nutrition & dietary goals
items: Log meals in text with an AI estimate of portions and nutrients for you to review.
Food diary, calories, macros and additional nutritional information.
Personal daily targets, remaining intake and AI nutrition summaries.

sections.title: Goals & progress
sections.summary: Follow your own journey over time.
items: Personal targets for body weight and other measurable achievements.
Entries, history, charts and goal completion tracking.
Share completed progress and control the visibility of your data.

sections.title: Personal AI coach
sections.summary: Ask questions and find your next step.
items: Chat about training, nutrition and your goals.
Suggestions informed by available profile information.
Training diary context is used with permission; AI responses are guidance, not a diagnosis or a guarantee of results.

sections.title: Health Card
items: Import results from PDFs, photos or the camera, then review values and dates.
Measurement history, charts, health score and an overview of tracked indicators.
Explanations and recommendations with sources; not a replacement for healthcare. Requires active access.

sections.title: Your gyms & entry
sections.summary: Stay connected to where you train.
items: Find gyms and view profiles, contacts, opening hours and rules.
Membership status, validity and payments depend on the participating gym’s system; gift entry where supported.
Phone entry, visit history, gym traffic and reviews where offered by your gym.

sections.title: People, messages & feed
sections.summary: Keep in touch and share progress.
items: Find profiles, exchange private messages and invite friends.
Share workouts and completed goals on the feed or outside the app.
Reactions, comments, hiding or reporting posts and gym announcements.

sections.title: For trainers
items: Create a trainer profile and present your specialities and services.
Public profile page and client communication.
Shared training diaries, comments and proposed changes within granted permissions.

sections.title: For gym owners
sections.summary: An everyday view of your business.
items: Manage the gym profile, public website, rules and contact details.
Memberships, customers, payment records, revenue and calendar depend on the gym’s active system.
Manage supported entry systems, visit history, member announcements and review replies.

sections.title: Diamond Club
sections.summary: Keep track of your activity rewards.
items: Earn diamonds for supported activities.
View your current balance and diamond history.
See ways to earn; planned discounts are not a promise of rewards available today.

sections.title: Profile & settings
items: Profile, photo gallery, bio, personal details, goals and food preferences.
Language, units, notification settings and privacy for selected information.
Manage your account and password, including account deletion.
